issues.issue: Confirmed as a report gap, not a misread: the Total Nonmajor Funds column prints TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS 2,699,237 clearly; its lines (46,120 + 1,272,582 + 116,043 + 53,220 + 1,009,239 + 202,033 + 214,141) add to 2,913,378, i.e. the printed total leaves out Capital Outlay 214,141. Excess (251,865) follows the wrong total; Net Change 52,912 and the p4 nonmajor column 2,913,378 use the right one. Recorded correctly; listed for information.

Split from Miscellaneous 2,202,552 per the Statement of Activities general receipts (adds up exactly, so the split is printed). Category is a judgement (self-insurance fund receipts). The same money in the Health Insurance Fund detail (detail[44], Miscellaneous 1,821,409) stays category other, so statement and detail disagree.
The category rules put cemetery under health/welfare; the report prints it under General Government. Either is defensible.

issues.issue: The funds with combining columns account for public safety 1,062,177 and capital outlay 102,069, so these two funds together hold public safety 210,405 and capital outlay 112,072. The report doesn't print which fund holds which, so recording both as public safety is acceptable, but 112,072 of capital outlay sits in public safety in detail. The same goes for the three funds' 'Receipts' (other): the Total column implies intergovernmental 87,461, charges for services 7,743 and miscellaneous 136,351 among them.
